description: EPA-SWMM models and indicator summary data for four reservoir irrigation districts, South Korea is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ji-Hyeon Shin, WONHO NAM (Hankyong National University). This repository provides the EPA-SWMM hydraulic model files and processed water management indicator data supporting the study "A process-based, multidimensional water management indicator framework for reservoir irrigation districts: Development and cross-district evaluation" (Shin & Nam, Agricultural Water Management). Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
